arms.A: existing per-order full JSON dossier/sheet/assemble path; normal efficient use permitted
arms.B: source-once readable packet and explicit CSV decision path

design: identical six frozen full dossiers and source availability in both arms; four previously accepted replicas plus two deliberately blocked controls; no prior decision/rationale/review contents supplied
ownership_exposure: Both arms receive identical ownership/routing metadata. This reveals existing proposal ownership; this is a replication cost experiment, not a blinded outcome-discovery trial.
publication: experimental proposals only; original Sol authorship and canonical statuses/census/claims preserved
review_standard: fresh independent source reading; every member earlier-end/scope/independent-command/savings/cutoff check; allow unable outcomes; no human certification
stop_rule: unsupported conclusion or packet loss requires correction and independent rereview; all initial failures retained
telemetry: own agent rollout per-response counters and outer calls if exposed; active time only if observed; do not infer tokens from bytes
